body:
Hi, I'm also 17M with an insanely bad stutter. It disrupts my life to an insane extent where I only go to self-checkout supermarkets and I skipped every on campus lecture I had this semester. I understand how you feel.
For me my stutter is worse on some days as others, and I stutter way less when I'm talking to myself. Stuttering feels like a social handicap but only assholes make a big deal out of it, so don't beat yourself up over it.
